name: photo-culling-tool-executors
description: Dependencies for photo culling tool executor scripts

notes.sharp: Image processing: resize, grayscale, convolve (Laplacian sharpness). Required for sharpness scoring.
notes.exifr: Fast EXIF metadata extraction (DateTimeOriginal, camera info, orientation). Required for timestamp burst grouping.
notes.@vladmandic/face-api: Face detection + 68-point landmark model. Optional — enables face count and eye-open/closed detection via EAR.
notes.@tensorflow/tfjs-node: TensorFlow.js backend for face-api. Required if using face detection.
